output.reason: [ev-1d4a9d664d8c] lists this under Feature and says only that cert-manager now adds an `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cert-manager` label to the Let's Encrypt account keys it creates. It does not mention any failure, rejection, ignored setting, loss of access or required operator step, so no action-eligible kind is supported. Adding a label is purely extra information on the keys. The idea that it changes behaviour (P4) depends on guessing about label selectors in a customer environment, and the evidence does not say that. So "none" (informational, low severity) is the best-supported consequence.
